procedure: Pages rendered with pdfplumber page.to_image(resolution=220-800); the seven pages are PORTRAIT sheets whose rotated landscape tables read upright after PIL ROTATE_90 ('Tippah County 2026 General Election' banner -- cache/2026-scan-assessment/tier1/tippah/; this county's rotation is opposite Chickasaw's/Carroll's). FIRST-PASS MIRROR-READ REPAIRS: p2's rows were first transcribed from an upside-down (ROTATE_270) render whose readings ran reversed; the ROTATE_90 render and the printed TOTALs settled them (Brownfield's Colom cell prints 9, not 90; the Hicks/Liddy cells read as p2 325/345). Every in-scope row's cross-page cell sum equals its printed TOTAL exactly (19/19).
structure_note: Same 7-page shape: p1 the certification/signature page; p2+p3 = table A's two column groups over the county's 21 precincts (Blue Mountain/.../North Ripley, then Palmer/.../Walnut + TOTAL), ending at Chancery 18 Place 1's two rows; p4+p5 = table B (same column split) carrying Chancery 18 Place 2 and Circuit 3's Places, then the local Election Commissioner rows; p6+p7 = the Election Commissioner 1 rows' remaining column groups (declared local_only). The p4 print repeats the BENTON LATE-HEADER SHAPE: Chancery 18 Place 2's two rows (Jennifer L. Shackelford, Michael Watts) print at the table-B top with the 'Chancery Court 18-Chancery District 18 Place 2' header box BELOW them; 'Circuit Court 3-Circuit District 03 Place 1' prints below Bob Whitwell's row, 'Place 2' below Gray Tollison's, and the 'Place 3' box mid-block between Steven Patrick Jubera and Kent E. Smith -- so Tippah pairs Circuit 3 as Place 1 = Bob Whitwell, Place 2 = Gray Tollison, Place 3 = Bart M. Adams + Shirley C. Byers + Steven Patrick Jubera + Kent E. Smith, the same printed pairing Benton/Lafayette/Calhoun print (and Union/Chickasaw's P1=Tollison sheet is the deviant print); the family-level roster reads identical across all six Circuit 3 counties. Races: U.S. Senate; US House Of Rep 01-1st Congressional District (Johnny Baucom, Cliff Johnson, Trent Kelly -- the House 1 roster, names identical); Court Of Appeals 01-District 1 Position 1 (Derek Dewayne Hopson Jr., John Weddle) and Position 2 (Donna M. Barnes) -- the same CoA 1 roster, names identical; Chancery Court 18-Chancery District 18 Place 1 (Jenessa Carter Hicks, Sarah J. Liddy), Place 2 (Jennifer L. Shackelford, Michael Watts) -- the same Chancery 18 roster three counties print, names identical (FOURTH county); Circuit Court 3 as paired above. Printed totals: Colom 1865, Hyde-Smith 5411, Pinkins 171, Baucom 93, Johnson 1683, Kelly 5659, Hopson 2510, Weddle 4102, D. Barnes 6165, Hicks 625, Liddy 603, Shackelford 4002, Watts 1661, Whitwell 6143, Tollison 6164, Adams 5676, Byers 929, Jubera 464, Kent E. Smith 6142.
operator_rows_note: All 19 in-scope rows supplied by operator_rows in ballot order; table-A rows carry p2+p3 cells + the p3 printed TOTAL; the Place 2 and Circuit 3 rows carry p4+p5 cells + the p5 printed TOTAL. No X cells print in any in-scope row.
truncation_note: No truncations; the twenty-one precinct headers print complete (Blue Mountain, Brownfield, Chalybeate, Chapman, 'Dry Creek', Dumas, FALKNER, Mitchell, New Hope, North Falkner, North Ripley, Palmer, Peoples, Pine Grove, Ripley, 'Shady Grove', Southwest Ripley, 'Spout Springs', Threeforks, Tiplersville, Walnut -- the county's sheet prints 'FALKNER' in caps and 'Tiplersville' (the town is 'Tipplersville') verbatim; kept as printed).
local_note: p4/p5 carry the local 'Election Commissioner District 1-Tippah County Election Commission District 1' rows (Larry (Doc) Dollar, Stephanie Ford, Tony Jones), and p6/p7 their remaining column groups -- local, out of scope, contributing no parse rows on operator-supply pages. Chancery 18's two Places and Circuit 3's three Places print in-county, so the families write Place-qualified labels (matching Benton's).
